paper_title: Genetic basis for coordination of meiosis and sexual structure maturation in Cryptococcus neoformans
authors: Liu L, He G-J, Chen L, Zheng J, Chen Y, Shen L, Tian X, Fang E, Xu Y, Wang L
target_figure_description: Violin plots of the basidial maturation score (BMS) for five strains (Wild-type, pum1Δ, csa1Δ, csa2Δ, csa1Δ/csa2Δ) during unisexual (grey) and bisexual (dark red) development; n=150 cells per strain per condition.
underlying_data: Per-cell BMS values are provided in Figure 2-source data 1 (sheet 'Figure 2A'); plotted verbatim.
